description: Version-local human-facing labels and concise operation/field explanations shared by editors and scanner reports. UI explanations do not alter grammar, datatypes or result semantics; source- and version-pinned native schema is authoritative.

authoring.target_platform.label: Target platform
authoring.target_platform.prompt: Which operating system will this Assessment check?
authoring.target_platform.description: Authoring context for choosing available capabilities. This editor-facing selection does not change native Assessment evaluation semantics or assert a CPE/applicability test.

assessment.assessment_title.label: Security requirement
assessment.assessment_title.prompt: What security requirement should be checked?
assessment.assessment_title.description: Human-authored summary, not an executable condition.

assessment.evaluate.label: How the checks combine
assessment.evaluate.description: Combines independent named Test outcomes; not a collection or State-field condition.

assessment.evaluate.and.label: All checks must pass
assessment.evaluate.and.description: Logical AND over Test/Assessment expressions. Do not infer behavior of absent evidence from this operator alone.

assessment.evaluate.all.label: All checks must pass
assessment.evaluate.all.description: Legacy input alias for and; generated authoring uses and. Logical AND over Test/Assessment expressions. Do not infer behavior of absent evidence from this operator alone.

assessment.evaluate.or.label: At least one check must pass
assessment.evaluate.or.description: Logical OR over Test/Assessment expressions. This does not imply any particular Item-existence requirement.

assessment.evaluate.any.label: At least one check must pass
assessment.evaluate.any.description: Legacy input alias for or; generated authoring uses or. Logical OR over Test/Assessment expressions. This does not imply any particular Item-existence requirement.

assessment.evaluate.one.label: Exactly one check must pass
assessment.evaluate.one.description: Logical ONE over Test/Assessment expressions, independent of Item cardinality.

assessment.evaluate.xor.label: An odd number of checks must pass
assessment.evaluate.xor.description: Logical XOR (odd parity) over Test/Assessment expressions; not exactly-one for three or more operands.

assessment.evaluate.odd.label: An odd number of checks must pass
assessment.evaluate.odd.description: Legacy input alias for xor; generated authoring uses xor.

test.capability.label: How to inspect
test.capability.prompt: Which capability will collect the evidence?

test.object.label: Data source
test.object.description: An Object specifies what evidence to collect, not the expected outcome. Inline Objects inherit the enclosing Test capability; independently shared Objects declare it.

object.object_title.label: Data source title
object.object_title.description: Preserve meaningful titles. Omit null object_title on private inline/local Objects, including nested private Set operands. Named/shared Object metadata contracts remain unchanged.

object.select.label: Where to look
object.select.description: Capability-specific selectors; do not confuse an Object selector with a State expectation.

test.states.label: What must be true
test.states.prompt: Which expected fields or values should be checked?

test.states_match.label: Combine expected conditions on one collected item
test.states_match.prompt: How must the State entries apply to the same collected item?

all.label: All conditions
all.description: Evaluate each State entry as authored on the same collected item.

test.require.label: How many collected items must exist and match?
test.require.description: Test-level existence and matching scope. Use the exact versioned requirement token; do not silently reinterpret unknown, error, incomplete, or empty collection outcomes.

state.field.require.label: How many values of this field must exist and match?
state.field.require.description: Applies inside a collected item to the State field (or record member) being checked, not to the collection of Tests.

state.field.equals.label: Must equal
state.field.equals.description: Exact comparison as defined by the authored field's datatype.

state.field.matches_regex.label: Must match pattern
state.field.matches_regex.description: Regular-expression comparison, not a literal-text comparison; a Guided literal-text field may escape the pattern for the author.

object.shared_reference.label: Use an existing data source
object.shared_reference.description: Referenced shared Object must resolve in this Assessment's authoring context.

expression.for_each.label: Repeat for each collected item
expression.for_each.description: Correlation and source scoping must be preserved; the authoring UI must not turn per-parent requirements into a global union.

test.require.items.label: Required collected Items
test.require.items.description: Explicit number of Items that must exist before applying matching predicates. Existence is separate from State matching.

test.require.items.one_or_more.label: At least one Item must exist
test.require.items.one_or_more.description: The collection must contain one or more selected Items. An empty collection does not satisfy this requirement.

test.require.items.may_be_absent.label: Items may be absent
test.require.items.may_be_absent.description: No minimum number of selected Items is required; matching and incomplete/error status remain independently significant.

test.require.all_items_must.label: Every collected Item must satisfy
test.require.all_items_must.description: Apply the enclosed expected conditions independently to every selected Item. This does not itself require that any Item exists.

test.require.all_items_must.and.label: All conditions must match
test.require.all_items_must.and.description: Logical AND of the expected field/record conditions on the same collected Item; field-level cardinality is independent.

test.require.all_items_must.or.label: At least one condition must match
test.require.all_items_must.or.description: Logical OR over expected State alternatives on the same collected Item. It does not mean that at least one collected Item must exist.

object.capability_inheritance.label: Collection capability
object.capability_inheritance.description: An inline Object inherits its enclosing Test capability. A shared or independently addressable Object declares its capability explicitly.

state.field.type.label: Collected value type
state.field.type.description: Interpretation is capability-specific; for Windows Registry this is the stored Registry type, not necessarily the comparison datatype.

independent.textfilecontent54.label: Read and match text from a file
independent.textfilecontent54.description: Text collection and pattern/instance selection; do not assume complete-file or rendered-login-banner equivalence.

name.label: Value name
name.prompt: Which named value (or supported default value)?

type.label: Registry storage type
type.prompt: Which kind of Registry data must this entry contain?
type.description: The Registry value TYPE, such as dword, string or multi_string. This is distinct from the comparison datatype of the data stored in value.

value.label: Stored Registry value
value.description: Comparison datatype must be selected explicitly when ambiguous, and must be compatible with the asserted Registry type. The mapping's semantic validator governs cross-type compatibility.

conformance_rules: Never synthesize native enumeration values from displayed labels.
Resolve *_source pointers only within the same pinned capability mapping.
If a referenced enum is missing or mismatched, disable the affected control rather than supplying a guessed list.
Display text is advisory; the normative schema and semantic contract win any disagreement.
Editors and scanners SHALL resolve displayed operation titles from the same version-pinned vocabulary catalog; titles never replace machine-readable operation identifiers.
Descriptions explain author intent, not authoritative six-state scanner outcomes; native evaluation semantics and versioned schema remain controlling.

equals.label: Equals
equals.description: Compare the collected field value with the expected value, according to its native datatype.

not_equal.label: Does not equal
not_equal.description: Compare for inequality using the field's native comparison datatype.

case_insensitive_equals.label: Equals, ignoring case
case_insensitive_equals.description: Perform a case-insensitive string equality comparison.

matches_regex.label: Matches regular expression
matches_regex.description: Use regular-expression pattern matching; not literal substring matching.

greater_than.label: Greater than
greater_than.description: Compare values using the operation's supported datatype and ordering.

greater_than_or_equal.label: Greater than or equal to
greater_than_or_equal.description: Compare values using the operation's supported datatype and ordering.

less_than.label: Less than
less_than.description: Compare values using the operation's supported datatype and ordering.

less_than_or_equal.label: Less than or equal to
less_than_or_equal.description: Compare values using the operation's supported datatype and ordering.

and.label: All conditions must match
and.description: All nested conditions in this Boolean group must hold under native multi-state result semantics.

or.label: At least one condition must match
or.description: At least one nested condition in this Boolean group must hold under native multi-state result semantics.
